findings.source_quote: “Thy sins be forgiven thee.” Then He said, “Rise up and walk.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted sayings exactly as printed in the authoritative English, without adding words. Replace the translation that adds an address with a faithful rendering of the English phrase. For example: “‘Teus pecados te são perdoados.’ Depois disse: ‘Levanta‑te e anda.’” (preserve punctuation and the order of the two statements as in the source).
findings.translation_quote: “Filho, perdoados te são os teus pecados.” Depois disse: “Levanta‑te, toma o teu leito e vai para tua casa.”
